topic: Chameleon: its eyes move separately to look two ways at once, and its sticky tongue shoots out faster than you can blink.

episode.title: Chameleon: Eyes Everywhere!

shots.narration: Did you know chameleon eyes can look two ways at once?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated jungle, cute realistic chameleon on a sunlit branch, no text.
shots.action: The chameleon swivels its eyes in different directions.
shots.mood: Sunny green foliage, sparkling eyes, playful wonder.

shots.narration: Kiko can only check one direction at a time!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny 3D jungle clearing, leafy branches surrounding Kiko, Pip perched on his hat.
shots.action: Kiko swings his binoculars from left to right.

shots.narration: [surprised] But this little explorer has a different trick.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, realistic 3D chameleon on a foreground branch, Kiko watching from behind.
shots.action: The chameleon rotates one eye while its other eye stays still.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight, clear eye detail, gentle surprise.

shots.narration: Its eyes move separately, watching different directions.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close frontal view of a realistic 3D chameleon among bright jungle leaves.
shots.action: The chameleon turns its eyes toward opposite sides of the frame.

shots.narration: And those eyes aren't its only superpower.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, side view of a chameleon on a branch, Pip perched safely behind it.

shots.narration: [excited] Its sticky tongue shoots out faster than you can blink!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, close side view of a realistic 3D chameleon, open jungle space ahead, no prey visible.
shots.action: The chameleon launches its tongue beyond the frame.
shots.mood: Bright daylight, thrilling motion, gentle nature-film excitement.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D jungle clearing, Kiko beside the chameleon's branch, Pip on his hat.
shots.action: Kiko blinks with an astonished expression.

shots.narration: Separate-moving eyes and a speedy, sticky tongue: super discovery!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny 3D jungle, calm chameleon on its branch beside Kiko, Pip perched nearby.
shots.action: Kiko gives the chameleon a delighted thumbs-up.
shots.mood: Triumphant smiles, bright natural colours, friendly wonder.

shots.narration: [excited] Which animal's superpower comes next? Make your guess!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D jungle trail disappearing behind oversized leaves, Pip perched on Kiko's hat.
shots.action: Kiko parts the leaves at the trail entrance.
shots.mood: Sunny mystery, inviting adventure, lush green depth.

episode.endHook: Another wild superpower awaits! Which animal do you think comes next?
episode.description: Kiko and Pip discover a chameleon's amazing independent eyes and lightning-fast sticky tongue. Can you guess which animal's real superpower we'll explore next?
